text: 尽管伊朗战争推高能源价格，持续加重企业经营压力，德国9月工业产出仍意外增长。德国联邦统计局周五公布，9月工业产出环比增长0.7%，低于经下修后8月1.0%的增幅。此前，经济学家普遍预计将环比下降0.2%。这一增长为德国工业部门逐步复苏提供了新的初步迹象，尽管能源价格仍构成持续压力。9月工厂订单也大幅增长，而10月制造业采购经理人调查显示，行业活动进一步回升，但增速有所放缓。
text_en: Despite the Iran war pushing up energy prices and continuously adding to corporate operating pressure, Germany's September industrial production unexpectedly grew. The Federal Statistical Office announced on Friday that September industrial production rose 0.7% month on month, below the revised 1.0% increase in August. Economists had generally expected a 0.2% month-on-month decline. The increase provides new preliminary signs of a gradual recovery in Germany's industrial sector, although energy prices remain a persistent pressure. September factory orders also rose sharply, while the October manufacturing PMI survey showed further recovery in sector activity, but at a slower pace.
